digest.component_or_area: store write lock and compaction sweep
propositions: A blocked session cannot determine what is holding the store write lock or whether interrupting it is safe, seeing only a bare pid in the lock timeout error.
Compaction sweeps hold locks for extended periods and are safely interruptible without data loss, but operators cannot identify a holder as a sweep from timeout messages alone.
The lock owner stamp and timeout messages must name the operation (compact-sweep) and provide remediation guidance to make manual identification unnecessary.
An ambient operation_label context manager using contextvars must propagate a colon-free op= field through the lock acquisition path without modifying acquisition call sites.
The v2 lock stamp format must remain colon-free and forward-compatible when the optional op= field is added and parsed.
